status: What the ontology lacks to answer evals/dev/brand-requirements/proposed_items.json: one entry per stage area or rule group of Laura Abate's Draft 6 as the source record states it. The 12 stages and 15 rules themselves are stakeholder proposals; the map body is not read here, so a gap names an area, not a numbered stage. Each gap names the existing types and bindings it can reuse. A gap that needs a person names a question for Laura or Regulatory.

gaps.name: CustomerBrandRequirement (a requirement scoped to customer, brand/product line and product exceptions, with category, source document, date, contact, completeness/currentness)
gaps.map_says: account managers enter requirements; Regulatory reviews or is notified
gaps.implementation: the draft states no portal code audit; any Portal statement is unverified
gaps.ontology_today: Customer and Product exist; the Portal's customer and project requirement tables are not_served and unread for the map's fields.
gaps.open_question: Laura or Regulatory: do the Portal's customer and project requirement rows hold the map's scope, category, source document, date and contact, and who owns a requirement's currentness?

gaps.name: Requirement.applies_to (brand/product line and product exceptions resolved to one product)
gaps.map_says: requirements are scoped to brand and product line with product-level exceptions
gaps.implementation: the draft states no portal code audit; any Portal statement is unverified
gaps.ontology_today: Product carries no brand-line scope link and no requirement link.

gaps.name: ComplianceDocument on a supplier-specific raw-material R number (type, supported claims, issue and expiry dates, reviewer)

gaps.implementation: the draft states no portal code audit; any Portal statement is unverified

gaps.open_question: Laura or Regulatory: where are compliance documents (organic, kosher, RSPO and similar) filed today and which fields identify the R number and supplier?
